angle: Movement translation, all five groups screened on the start-from-stance movement each drills (OL kick-slide, DL get-off, WR/TE release, DB backpedal): per-player similarity of the 1.5 s speed + acceleration profile in matching Combine drills (combine_frames) vs random NFL snaps (game_frames_sample), each read against peers. Receivers chosen by a stated rule (noise ceiling >= 0.5, individual production stat, highest lower bound on translation); tested against career yards per route run beyond three no-tracking baselines, leave-one-class-out.
metric_name: Release Match: minus the mean absolute gap (sd vs peers) between a receiver's Combine route-drill release profile and his NFL release profile, 0-1.5 s after first movement (0.5 yd/s), 16 speed + 16 acceleration points, sample-size noise removed
headline_number: Drill release ranks NFL release rho 0.16 [-0.03, 0.35] (n=75) vs noise ceiling 0.66 (25% of it), weight -0.31, official 40 0.17; Release Match +0.09 yds/route per sd [90%: -0.07, +0.26], n=62, full baseline (pick-only +0.10, pick+slot +0.09), held-out R2 change -0.09 to -0.13; Match reliability 0.29, power 27% at the 0.15 margin; play level: release 1 sd quicker than own norm = +0.09 yd separation [0.00, 0.19], cushion +0.08 yd/s per yd.
what_changed_from_previous: New take on the translation angle rather than a revision of round-22 cand_3 (Stem Gear) or the DL first-step line: (1) a five-group screen with noise ceilings decides the group by a stated rule, exposing that OL kick-slide translation is unmeasurable (drill reps disagree -0.11, within-role NFL set reliability 0.00) and DL get-off does not carry once edge/interior are separated (0.03); (2) the release is aligned on first movement and profiled across all 13 WR route drills (median 13 reps, reliability 0.64) instead of one go-route rep; (3) three baselines side by side with nested LOCO refitted in every bootstrap draw; (4) measurement-error simulation sized to the observed reliability; (5) play-level validity check (separation, cushion) gives the release football meaning; (6) player-card grid with greyed cards where the gap is not clear of noise; two-sentence lede and a Monday block.
open_risks: Null-leaning, underpowered result (power 27% at the margin); 'not shown, not ruled out' may read as inconclusive.

Group choice rule was written after the screen was computed (before any held-out production run); DBs edge WRs on translation lower bound (0.00 vs -0.03) and are excluded only for lacking an individual coverage stat.
Route x alignment standardisation of the NFL side was a design choice; without route standardisation WR translation is 0.21 (exploratory, not reported).
Release Match's noise adjustment is a linear residualisation on sqrt(1/reps + 1/snaps); other corrections could shift individual cards.
Coaching reads for named receivers (e.g. Thornton press, Thomas Jr. controlled release) are interpretation, not film-verified.
Overlaps the receiver focus of round-23 cand_2 (Break G), though on a different movement (release, not the cut).
